title: ExaTrack: Vmcloudoor Linux backdoor poses as cloud agents on Alibaba, Tencent and Huawei VMs
date_note: Date of ExaTrack's publication; the page gives no earlier discovery date.
org: Linux virtual machines on Chinese cloud platforms
summary: ExaTrack reported on 19 November a Linux backdoor it calls Vmcloudoor, found during a hunting session, that disguises itself as a host agent on cloud virtual machines. According to ExaTrack, it renames its process to match the cloud provider's agents and takes commands through Alibaba OSS storage; the targeted environments are Alibaba (mainly), Tencent and Huawei. ExaTrack assumes the author is a Chinese pentester, potentially running red team engagements.
plain: Researchers at ExaTrack found hidden remote-control software for Linux servers on Alibaba, Tencent and Huawei clouds that pretends to be the cloud provider's own helper program, so administrators are less likely to notice it.
exec: A backdoor that hides as the cloud provider's own agent targets Linux servers on Alibaba, Tencent and Huawei clouds, ExaTrack reports.
action: General advice: on Alibaba, Tencent and Huawei cloud servers, check processes that carry cloud agent names, and hunt with the indicators and YARA rule ExaTrack published with its report.

key_findings: Vmcloudoor is a Linux x64 implant found during a hunting session; ExaTrack obtained only its helper module.
It checks for cloud agent paths and processes and renames itself to match one, blending in with the processes of the targeted cloud environment.
Command and control runs through Alibaba OSS; the targeted environments are Alibaba (mainly), Tencent and Huawei.
ExaTrack assumes the author is a Chinese pentester, potentially running dedicated red team engagements.

validation.note: Single origin: ExaTrack, the firm that found the implant (exatrack.com, 19 Nov, read). GBHackers (23 Nov, read) only relays ExaTrack and is not independent. ExaTrack names no victims.

review.note: Compared title, date 19 Nov, hunting session, process renaming, Alibaba OSS C2, targeted clouds (Alibaba mainly), author assumption, IOCs and YARA against ExaTrack's page; GBHackers relays it (single_source correct)
